g.text: BIEU DO TUAN TU DA TANG (MULTI-TIER SEQUENCE DIAGRAM)
LUONG GIAO DICH TU DONG TRU KHO KHI THU NGAN XAC NHAN THANH TOAN HOA DON
Chon hoa don, nhap tien khach dua & Bam "Xac nhan thanh toan"
SELECT hd.*, cthd.*, b.* FROM hoa_don hd ... WHERE hd.ma_hoa_don = 45
Kiem tra trang thai hoa don hop le
1. Tong hop nhu cau nguyen lieu theo cong thuc BOM
[Tung chi tiet mon uong (ChiTietHoaDon trong HoaDon)]
2. Kiem tra so luong ton kho thuc te
SELECT * FROM nguyen_lieu WHERE ma_nl = ? FOR UPDATE
Giao dich @Transactional bi Rollback hoan toan!
HTTP 400 Bad Request (JSON thong bao loi thieu hang)
Hien thi Toast do: Canh bao thieu nguyen lieu khong the thanh toan!
3. Thuc hien tru kho & ghi nhat ky lich su kho
UPDATE nguyen_lieu SET so_luong_ton = tonSau WHERE ma_nl = ?
INSERT INTO lich_su_kho (ma_nl, ma_nv, ma_hoa_don, loai_gd, so_luong_thay_doi, ton_truoc, ton_sau, thoi_gian, ghi_chu)
Hoan tat tru kho tu dong
4. Cap nhat hoa don & mo trang thai ban
UPDATE hoa_don SET trang_thai='DA_THANH_TOAN', tien_thua=?, phien_ban=2 WHERE ma_hoa_don=45
UPDATE ban SET trang_thai = 'TRONG' WHERE ma_ban = ?
Commit giao dich CSDL @Transactional thanh cong
Tra ve doi tuong HoaDon da thanh toan
Hien thi hop thoai thanh toan thanh cong & In hoa don chinh thuc
Cap nhat ban ve mau xanh (TRONG)
